case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 207 of 2022 (Arising out of SLP (Criminal) No. 8423 of 2019)
summary: Challenge to High Court's reversal of appellant's juvenility determination; issue of age determination under Juvenile Justice Act via school records, birth certificate, and ossification test; birth certificate deemed unreliable due to delayed registration; school leaving certificate doubted due to lack of authenticity and school verification; medical opinion based on ossification test favored, but procedural compliance with Rule 12(3)(b) of JJ Rules, 2007 examined; standard of proof and priority of documentary evidence over medical reports discussed.
legal_provisions_cited: Rule 12(3)(b) of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Rules, 2007
Section 94 of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969, Sections 8(1)(a) and 10(1)(i)
The U.P. Panchayat Raj (Maintenance of Family Register) Rules, 1970
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; restoration of Additional Sessions Judge's order declaring appellant as juvenile; matter remanded for further proceedings consistent with law
